content: Reminder cadence evidence (cross-industry, healthcare and services): single 24h-out reminder cuts no-shows around 30 percent; adding a 1-2h-before reminder pushes reduction past 50 percent. Sweet spot is 2-3 reminders (booking confirmation plus around 24-48h out plus day-of nudge); more than 3 causes reminder fatigue. Solutionreach 2019 study found right cadence and timing raised confirmation rates 156 percent.
